title: Workflow IR V2 Alpha OperationResult
description: Normative wire projection of the OperationResult envelope (alpha spec section 6): the normalized outcome of exactly one operation attempt, as returned by workers in any language and recorded by the journal. Status-discriminated lowercase forms; no nulls on the wire (absent is the only empty state); cross-language equivalence is canonical byte equality (RFC 8785). Frozen at Step 2.5; evolution within workflow/v2alpha is additive-only.

output.$comment: Deliberately open: the operation's output value; any JSON value except null (a void-like operation omits output entirely).

code.$comment: Stable machine-matchable code. Reserved codes (section 6): OPERATION_TIMEOUT, INTERRUPTED, UNHANDLED_EXCEPTION.

retryable.$comment: Advisory input to the interpreter's retry policy, never a command (section 17 gate item 3).

origin.$comment: Optional crashed-vs-failed distinction: infra = the environment broke; code = the operation's own logic failed. Producers set it when they know it and omit it when they don't.

details.$comment: Deliberately open: diagnostics, cause chains, stack traces - permitted under section 11 disclosure rules.

usage.$comment: Evidence-ledger metrics for the attempt; the agent-controller computes J (cost to jury-verified result) from these. First-class fields, not attributes (DD-19 bright line).
